purpose: Independent first-party registry/map discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: BIDA provides local Bhiwadi authority evidence and Rajasthan's Urban GIS Portal/Bhu-Naksha provide official cadastral-map discovery routes. The current viewer points to an ArcGIS Khasra layer, but bounded anonymous metadata and point requests timed out; no sample was retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: Local custody is evidenced by Bhiwadi Integrated Development Authority. State cadastral/map custody is evidenced by Rajasthan Urban GIS and Bhu-Naksha. Neither was verified as an open, responsive, Bhiwadi-specific vector parcel service.
